editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in the wild world of Los Angeles real estate, where everyone is lying and money is everything. You follow a disgraced property broker who gets a chance to get back on top when a rich, mysterious guy and his beautiful wife hire him to sell a secret Malibu villa. It starts off as a fancy business deal, but it quickly turns into a wild ride full of cheating, double-crosses, and straight-up murder. The vibe is like a dark comedy that pokes fun at how greedy people in LA can be, keeping you guessing about who is actually playing whom.

What really works here is how the plot twists every time you think you have it figured out. The acting is solid, and the pacing keeps things moving so you never get bored. While some of the plot jumps feel a bit rushed, the overall chaos makes it a fun watch. If you are in the mood for a crime caper, you should definitely check it out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality for those gorgeous Malibu views.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a massive reveal about who was actually pulling the strings. After all the betrayal and fighting over the property, the broker realizes he was just a pawn in a much bigger game played by the power couple. In the end, the greedy characters get what they deserve through a series of clever traps. The broker manages to survive the madness and walk away, while the villains lose their grip on the wealth they fought so hard to keep.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves movies about rich people getting tricked.
